Fleabag" was Phoebe Waller-Bridge’s real-life childhood nickname given to her by her family.She adopted the moniker for her acclaimed one-woman show and subsequent television series because it captured the messy, rough-around-the-edges vulnerability hidden beneath a composed exterior. In the show itself, the central character's real name is never actually spoken, fitting a pattern where many characters like "The Priest" or "The Godmother" are known only by their descriptive titles.

The series  won six Primetime Emmy Awards in 2019, including Outstanding Comedy Series, because its raw look at grief, humor, and connection struck a deep chord with viewers and critics alike.
